report.value: No part covers VBUS, D+, D-, CC1 and CC2 and holds D+/D- at 3.63 V steady (V12, V13). The function stays with no ranked part. P3's route needs three elements, not one part. (a) A USB repeater between the connector's D+/D- and USB_DP/USB_DM. Its side 2 drives VOH 2.8 to 3.6 V from the 3.3 V rail, so the steady level at the RP2354B's pins is set by a driver, not by an OVP threshold. ISOUSB111 rates its connector-side bus pins at -0.3 to 6 V for 1000 short events and 1000 h, and CIO_xDx is 10 pF max; it fails rule 4 at JLCPCB (33). ADuM3160 and ADuM4160 are in stock (5068 and 5531). They rate their connector-side inputs at VDD1 + 0.5 V, at most 4.1 V, so a steady 5 V on the connector's D+ is outside their rating. (b) A connector-side array for IEC 61000-4-2 level 4 on every line: none of the repeaters has an IEC rating. (c) A CC1/CC2 element such as TPD2S300 (VOVPCC_RISE 5.55 to 6.18 V, IEC +/-8 kV contact and +/-15 kV air on CC). Not shown: the RP2354B's soft connect and BOOTSEL re-enumeration through a repeater, and any repeater's clamping at 16 A TLP. The owner decides whether the USB protection may be a set of parts and whether V12's steady limit binds against an external source. Only then can a set be qualified
